title: Health Promotion in schools, workplaces and the community

titles.subject: Psychology
titles.leaf: Health Promotion in schools, workplaces and the community

author: GGWXGhP7McKTXiTQc
chapter_outcomes: Describe strategies for promoting health; fear arousal (use of fear to improve health, including a study, e.g. Janis and Feshbach (1953)), and providing information (giving information so people know how to improve their health, including a study, e.g. Lewin et al. (1992))
Describe and evaluate health promotion in schools with a focus on healthy eating, including a study, e.g. Tapper et al. (2003)
Describe and evaluate health promotion in worksites with a focus on health and safety, including a study, e.g. Fox et al. (1987)
Describe unrealistic optimism as a reason for disregarding positive health advice, including a study, e.g. Weinstein (1980)
Define positive psychology including three focuses; pleasant life, good life, meaningful life, including a study, e.g. Seligman (2004)
Describe and evaluate the application of positive psychology (exemplified by the key study on using positive psychology in schools to improve mental health: Shoshani and Steinmetz (2014))
